run_substr_indexing: run the pipeline to build substring index for shards using tar archives
run_entry_count: run the pipeline to count entries across data shards
run_balance_sampling: run the pipeline to build a balanced subset index from shards
review_shard_text_loader: review the shard_text_loader function that extracts text and image offsets from tar shards
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional pipeline steps beyond substr_indexing, entry_count, and balance_sampling
